"""KLASS (Kim et al., "KLASS: KL-Guided Fast Inference in Masked Diffusion
Models", NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2511.05664) -- the starter's own code.

Block regime: a port of `stable_confident_decode` (alg="klass",
unmask_strategy="all") from github.com/shkim0116/KLASS src/model/llada_klass.py:
ready = (KL(p_t || p_{t-1}) < eps over the last `history_length` steps) & (max
prob > tau) & masked-in-block; unmask every ready position, else the top-k by
confidence with k from the uniform schedule (lines 67-190).
Fully parallel sampled regime (the MDLM-OWT text protocol): KLASS Sec. 6.2 /
App. D.2.1 -- fixed step count, the number of tokens accepted by the thresholds
capped per step, fallback to MDLM's ancestral update. Confidence and KL use the
full softmax (App. B Algorithm 1: P = softmax(l), c = max P); accepted tokens
are drawn with nucleus p (the harness's top_p)."""

_FILE = "LLaDA/custom_demask_eval.py"

_CONTENT = r'''class DemaskDecoder:
    """Masked-diffusion decoding strategy (starter: KLASS, Kim et al., NeurIPS 2025).

    decode() fills `gen_length` masked positions after the prompt in
    `gen_length // block_length` blocks, left to right, using at most `steps`
    model calls in total, and returns (x [1, prompt_len + gen_length], steps used).

    temperature == 0 -> argmax tokens; > 0 -> sampled (with top_p nucleus).
    When block_length == gen_length the whole sequence is one block (fully
    parallel decoding).

    Per-position quantities are computed only for the still-masked positions
    (rows of the logits); a decision never depends on the other rows.
    """

    def __init__(self, mask_id: int, temperature: float = 0.0, top_p: float = 1.0,
                 conf_threshold: float = 0.9, kl_threshold: float = 0.01,
                 history_length: int = 2):
        self.mask_id = mask_id
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.top_p = top_p
        self.conf_threshold = conf_threshold
        self.kl_threshold = kl_threshold
        self.history_length = history_length

    @torch.no_grad()
    def decode(self, model, input_ids, gen_length: int, steps: int,
               block_length: int):
        mid = self.mask_id
        P = input_ids.shape[1]
        L = P + gen_length
        x = torch.full((1, L), mid, dtype=torch.long, device=model.device)
        x[:, :P] = input_ids.clone()
        assert gen_length % block_length == 0
        num_blocks = gen_length // block_length
        assert steps % num_blocks == 0
        steps_per_block = steps // num_blocks
        parallel = num_blocks == 1 and self.temperature > 0

        V = model.lm_head.out_features if hasattr(model, "lm_head") \
            else model.config.vocab_size
        kl_hist = torch.zeros((L, self.history_length), dtype=torch.float64,
                              device=x.device)
        p_prev = torch.zeros((L, V), dtype=torch.float64, device=x.device)
        pos = torch.arange(L, device=x.device)
        used = 0
        eps = 1e-12
        for b in range(num_blocks):
            bs = P + b * block_length
            be = bs + block_length
            num_xfer = get_num_transfer_tokens((x[:, bs:be] == mid),
                                               steps_per_block)
            for step in range(steps_per_block):
                masked = x[0] == mid
                in_block = masked & (pos >= bs) & (pos < be)
                if not in_block.any():
                    break
                logits = model(x).logits[0]
                used += 1
                idx = masked.nonzero().squeeze(1)          # all masked rows
                lg = logits[idx]
                p_curr = F.softmax(lg.to(torch.float64), dim=-1)
                conf_m, top_m = p_curr.max(dim=-1)
                kl_m = (p_curr * (torch.log(p_curr + eps)
                                  - torch.log(p_prev[idx] + eps))).sum(-1)
                h = torch.roll(kl_hist[idx], -1, dims=-1)
                h[:, -1] = kl_m
                kl_hist[idx] = h
                p_prev[idx] = p_curr
                if step >= self.history_length - 1:
                    stable_m = torch.all(h < self.kl_threshold, dim=-1)
                else:
                    stable_m = torch.zeros_like(conf_m, dtype=torch.bool)
                blk_m = in_block[idx]
                ready_m = stable_m & (conf_m > self.conf_threshold) & blk_m
                if self.temperature > 0:
                    x0_m, _ = sample_tokens(lg, self.temperature, self.top_p)
                else:
                    x0_m = top_m
                last = step == steps_per_block - 1
                if last:
                    sel = blk_m
                elif parallel:
                    # Fixed-step text regime (KLASS Sec. 6.2): accept ready
                    # tokens, at most the schedule's count per step; otherwise
                    # fall back to MDLM's ancestral update.
                    k = int(num_xfer[0, step].item())
                    if ready_m.any():
                        c = torch.where(ready_m, conf_m, torch.full_like(conf_m, -1.0))
                        n = min(k, int(ready_m.sum().item()))
                        sel = torch.zeros_like(blk_m)
                        sel[torch.topk(c, n).indices] = True
                    else:
                        remaining = steps_per_block - step
                        sel = blk_m & (torch.rand(blk_m.shape, device=x.device)
                                       < 1.0 / remaining)
                elif ready_m.any():
                    sel = ready_m
                else:
                    c = torch.where(blk_m, conf_m, torch.full_like(conf_m, -math.inf))
                    k = int(num_xfer[0, step].item())
                    sel = torch.zeros_like(blk_m)
                    sel[torch.topk(c, k).indices] = True
                x[0, idx[sel]] = x0_m[sel]
        return x, used

"""Generation driver for the demasking-strategy task (masked diffusion LMs).

Only the `DemaskDecoder` class between the EDITABLE markers is yours. Everything
else is fixed: model loading, prompt construction, the forward-pass meter, the
per-sample budget and the file this process writes.

This process GENERATES; it does not score. It writes one JSON line per item
(the generated text, and for unconditional text the generated token ids, plus
the number of model forward passes the fixed meter counted) and exits. Scoring
happens afterwards in a separate process that never imports this file.

Forward passes are counted by a hook on the model's token-embedding module, so
every call to `model(x)` is charged, whatever the decoder reports: one unit per
row of `x`. A sample may use at most `steps` units; the call that would exceed
that raises `BudgetExceeded` inside `decode`, and a run with any over-budget
sample is not scored.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
import sys
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

LLADA_PATH = os.environ.get("LLADA_INSTRUCT_PATH", "/data/llada-instruct")
LLADA_MASK_ID = 126336
MDLM_REPO = "kuleshov-group/mdlm-owt"
MDLM_REVISION = "d0958fa851335ece6c15260ce0025f030673c0fb"
MDLM_TOKENIZER = "openai-community/gpt2-large"   # the GPT-2 BPE MDLM was trained with


class BudgetExceeded(RuntimeError):
    pass


class ForwardMeter:
    """Counts model forward passes (rows of the token batch) via the embedding module."""

    def __init__(self, embed_module: torch.nn.Module):
        self.units = 0
        self.limit = None
        embed_module.register_forward_pre_hook(self._hook)

    def _hook(self, module, args):
        ids = args[0] if args else None
        rows = int(ids.shape[0]) if torch.is_tensor(ids) and ids.dim() >= 2 else 1
        self.units += rows
        if self.limit is not None and self.units > self.limit:
            raise BudgetExceeded(f"{self.units} forward passes > budget {self.limit}")

    def start(self, limit: int):
        self.units, self.limit = 0, int(limit)

    def stop(self) -> int:
        self.limit = None
        return self.units


class _MDLMForDemask(torch.nn.Module):
    """`model(x).logits` for the released MDLM-OWT checkpoint.

    The backbone is called with sigma = 0 (the checkpoint is not time-conditioned,
    `time_conditioning: false`), and the logit of the [MASK] token is set to -inf:
    MDLM's SUBS parameterisation never predicts [MASK] (Sahoo et al., 2024, Sec. 3.2).
    """

    def __init__(self, hf_model):
        super().__init__()
        self.mdlm = hf_model
        self.config = hf_model.config
        self.mask_id = int(hf_model.config.vocab_size) - 1

    @property
    def device(self):
        return next(self.mdlm.parameters()).device

    def forward(self, input_ids):
        sigma = torch.zeros(input_ids.shape[0], device=input_ids.device)
        out = self.mdlm(input_ids=input_ids, timesteps=sigma)
        logits = (out.logits if hasattr(out, "logits") else out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out).float()
        logits[..., self.mask_id] = float("-inf")
        return SimpleNamespace(logits=logits)


def load_model(name: str, device: str = "cuda"):
    """Returns (model, tokenizer, mask_id, embedding module to meter)."""
    from transformers import AutoModel, AutoModelForMaskedLM, AutoTokenizer
    if name == "llada":
        tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(LLADA_PATH, trust_remote_code=True)
        mdl = AutoModel.from_pretrained(LLADA_PATH, trust_remote_code=True,
                                        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16).to(device).eval()
        return mdl, tok, LLADA_MASK_ID, mdl.get_input_embeddings()
    if name == "mdlm":
        tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MDLM_TOKENIZER)
        hf = AutoModelForMaskedLM.from_pretrained(MDLM_REPO, revision=MDLM_REVISION,
                                                  trust_remote_code=True).to(device).eval()
        mdl = _MDLMForDemask(hf).eval()
        return mdl, tok, mdl.mask_id, hf.backbone.vocab_embed
    raise ValueError(name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fixed helpers (use them or not)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_num_transfer_tokens(mask_index, steps):
    """Uniform schedule: mask_num // steps tokens per step (+1 for the first
    mask_num % steps steps). LLaDA's linear-schedule count (generate.py)."""
    mask_num = mask_index.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    base = mask_num // steps
    remainder = mask_num % steps
    out = torch.zeros(mask_num.size(0), steps,
                      device=mask_index.device, dtype=torch.int64) + base
    for i in range(mask_num.size(0)):
        out[i, :remainder[i]] += 1
    return out


def nucleus_filter(logits, top_p: float):
    """Top-p (nucleus) filtering along the last dim: logits outside the smallest
    set of tokens whose probability mass reaches `top_p` are set to -inf
    (the sort and the running mass are computed in float32). top_p >= 1 is a
    no-op."""
    if top_p is None or top_p >= 1.0:
        return logits
    sorted_logits, sorted_idx = torch.sort(logits.float(), dim=-1, descending=True)
    cum = torch.softmax(sorted_logits, dim=-1).cumsum(dim=-1)
    remove = cum > top_p
    remove[..., 1:] = remove[..., :-1].clone()
    remove[..., 0] = False
    mask = torch.zeros_like(remove).scatter(-1, sorted_idx, remove)
    return logits.masked_fill(mask, float("-inf"))


def sample_tokens(logits, temperature: float, top_p: float = 1.0):
    """Token proposal x0 for each row of `logits` (any leading shape; pass only
    the rows you need): argmax when temperature == 0, else a float64 Gumbel-max
    draw from softmax(nucleus_filter(logits) / temperature)
    (float64 because low-precision Gumbel-max biases masked-diffusion sampling,
    arXiv:2409.02908). Returns (x0, probs of the filtered, tempered distribution)."""
    lg = nucleus_filter(logits.to(torch.float64), top_p)
    if temperature and temperature > 0:
        lg = lg / temperature
        probs = torch.softmax(lg, dim=-1)
        u = torch.rand_like(probs).clamp_min(1e-300)
        x0 = torch.argmax(probs / (-torch.log(u)), dim=-1)
    else:
        probs = torch.softmax(lg, dim=-1)
        x0 = torch.argmax(probs, dim=-1)
    return x0, probs

        num_blocks = gen_length // block_length
        assert steps % num_blocks == 0
        steps_per_block = steps // num_blocks
        parallel = num_blocks == 1 and self.temperature > 0

            else model.config.vocab_size
        kl_hist = torch.zeros((L, self.history_length), dtype=torch.float64,
                              device=x.device)
        p_prev = torch.zeros((L, V), dtype=torch.float64, device=x.device)

# END OF EDITABLE REGION
# ====================================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prompts (KLASS, src/llada_evaluation.py)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MATH_SYSTEM = ("Your task is to answer the question below. Give step by step "
               "reasoning before you answer, and when you're ready to answer, "
               "please use the format 'The final answer is'.")
CODE_SYSTEM = "You complete only Python code."


def _prompt_ids(tokenizer, task: str, item: dict, device):
    if task == "text":
        return torch.zeros((1, 0), dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    system = MATH_SYSTEM if task == "math" else CODE_SYSTEM
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system},
            {"role": "user", "content": item["prompt"]}]
    text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(msgs, add_generation_prompt=True,
                                         tokenize=False)
    return torch.tensor(tokenizer(text)["input_ids"], device=device).unsqueeze(0)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--task", choices=["math", "humaneval", "text"], required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--model", choices=["llada", "mdlm"], required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--inputs", default="", help="jsonl of {id, prompt} (math/humaneval)")
    ap.add_argument("--n-samples", type=int, default=0, help="text: number of sequences")
    ap.add_argument("--id-offset", type=int, default=0, help="text: id of the first sequence (shards)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--steps", type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--gen-length", type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--block-length", type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.0)
    ap.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--conf-threshold", type=float, default=0.9)
    ap.add_argument("--kl-threshold", type=float, default=0.01)
    ap.add_argument("--history-length", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    random.seed(args.seed)
    np.random.seed(args.seed)
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

    if args.task == "text":
        items = [{"id": args.id_offset + i} for i in range(args.n_samples)]
    else:
        with open(args.inputs) as fh:
            items = [json.loads(l) for l in fh if l.strip()]
    print(f"SETUP: task={args.task} model={args.model} items={len(items)} "
          f"steps={args.steps} gen_length={args.gen_length} "
          f"block_length={args.block_length}", flush=True)

    model, tokenizer, mask_id, embed = load_model(args.model, device)
    meter = ForwardMeter(embed)
    decoder = DemaskDecoder(mask_id=mask_id, temperature=args.temperature,
                            top_p=args.top_p, conf_threshold=args.conf_threshold,
                            kl_threshold=args.kl_threshold,
                            history_length=args.history_length)

    t0 = time.time()
    total_units = 0
    with open(args.out, "w") as out:
        for i, item in enumerate(items):
            ids = _prompt_ids(tokenizer, args.task, item, device)
            P = ids.shape[1]
            rec = {"id": item["id"], "over_budget": False, "error": None}
            meter.start(args.steps)
            try:
                x, self_steps = decoder.decode(model, ids.clone(), args.gen_length,
                                               args.steps, args.block_length)
            except BudgetExceeded as exc:
                x, self_steps = None, None
                rec["over_budget"] = True
                rec["error"] = str(exc)
            units = meter.stop()
            rec["units"] = units
            rec["self_steps"] = self_steps if isinstance(self_steps, int) else None
            gen = None
            if x is not None:
                ok = (torch.is_tensor(x) and x.dim() == 2 and x.shape[0] == 1
                      and x.shape[1] == P + args.gen_length
                      and bool((x[0, :P].to(ids.device) == ids[0]).all()))
                if ok:
                    gen = x[0, P:].detach().to("cpu", torch.long)
                else:
                    rec["error"] = "decode() returned a tensor of the wrong shape or altered the prompt"
            if gen is not None:
                rec["masks_left"] = int((gen == mask_id).sum().item())
                keep = gen[gen != mask_id].tolist()
                if args.task == "text":
                    keep = [t for t in keep if 0 <= t < len(tokenizer)]
                    rec["ids"] = keep
                    rec["text"] = tokenizer.decode(keep)
                else:
                    rec["text"] = tokenizer.decode(keep, skip_special_tokens=True)
            else:
                rec["masks_left"] = args.gen_length
                rec["text"] = ""
                if args.task == "text":
                    rec["ids"] = []
            out.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")
            total_units += units
            if (i + 1) % 10 == 0 or i + 1 == len(items):
                print(f"TRAIN_METRICS: {args.task} {i + 1}/{len(items)} "
                      f"avg_steps={total_units / (i + 1):.2f} "
                      f"elapsed={time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    print(f"DONE: wrote {len(items)} generations", flush=True)

    main()
